  • Method Details

    • search

      default org.springframework.data.domain.Page<S> search(String searchTerm, org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable pageable)
      Search for entities matching the search term. To combine search with other conditions, use searchFor(String) with findAll(Specification, Pageable) instead.
      Parameters:
      searchTerm - the search term to use, can be null or empty
      pageable - the pageable to request a paged result, can be Pageable.unpaged(), must not be null.
      Returns:
      a page of entities matching the search term (if any) or all entities if the search term is null or empty.

    • searchFor

      default org.springframework.data.jpa.domain.Specification<S> searchFor(String searchTerm)
      A Specification matching the search term against the entity's @Searchable fields, for combining search with other conditions: 
      articles.findAll(articles.searchFor(term).and(isPublished()), pageable);

      It matches exactly what search(String, Pageable) matches: every word of the term in at least one searchable field (see Searchables.createSearchPredicate(String, Root, CriteriaBuilder)). A null or blank term matches every entity. It is an instance method so the entity type comes from the repository and chaining with and/or needs no type arguments.

      Parameters:
      searchTerm - the search term, may be null or blank
      Returns:
      the specification
